blocks.zh: 運營變更管理、定期審查、備份還原、資訊安全與歸檔管理
blocks.en: Operational Change Management, Periodic Review, Backup and Restore, Security Management and Archiving

blocks.zh: Learning Objectives 學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: Distinguish operational change management (post-go-live) from project change management, and understand how the same change process governance shifts the moment a system is released to production. 區分上線後的運營變更管理與專案變更管理的差異，理解系統交付生產後同一套變更管控如何轉型。
blocks.en: Distinguish operational change management (post-go-live) from project change management, and understand how the same change process governance shifts the moment a system is released to production.

blocks.zh: Identify the six GAMP 5 change types (standard, like-for-like, system administration, emergency, temporary, global) and apply the correct control pathway for each. 識別GAMP 5六大變更類型並為每種類型選擇正確的管控路徑。
blocks.en: Identify the six GAMP 5 change types (standard, like-for-like, system administration, emergency, temporary, global) and apply the correct control pathway for each.

blocks.zh: Design a risk-based periodic review programme — including frequency determination, review scope, and documented outcome — and understand why this activity is commonly under-resourced in CDMOs. 設計基於風險的定期審查計畫，理解為何CDMO企業常忽視此活動。
blocks.en: Design a risk-based periodic review programme — including frequency determination, review scope, and documented outcome — and understand why this activity is commonly under-resourced in CDMOs.

blocks.zh: Apply the RPO/RTO framework to backup strategy design, and explain why backup testing (restore verification) — not backup creation — is the audit-critical activity. 應用RPO/RTO框架設計備份策略，說明為何還原驗證才是稽核的關鍵焦點。
blocks.en: Apply the RPO/RTO framework to backup strategy design, and explain why backup testing (restore verification) — not backup creation — is the audit-critical activity.

blocks.zh: Evaluate security management requirements under GAMP 5 and 21 CFR Part 11, covering access control, MFA, shared accounts, audit trail integrity, and security patch management. 評估GAMP 5與21 CFR Part 11下的資訊安全要求，包括存取控制、MFA、共用帳號、稽核軌跡完整性與安全補丁管理。
blocks.en: Evaluate security management requirements under GAMP 5 and 21 CFR Part 11, covering access control, MFA, shared accounts, audit trail integrity, and security patch management.

blocks.zh: Explain electronic records archiving obligations — including readability over 30+ year retention periods, retrieval testing, and the distinction between archive and backup — and the regulatory expectations under 21 CFR Part 11 and EU GMP Annex 11. 說明電子記錄歸檔義務，包括30年以上保留期間的可讀性、檢索測試，以及21 CFR Part 11與EU GMP Annex 11的法規期望。
blocks.en: Explain electronic records archiving obligations — including readability over 30+ year retention periods, retrieval testing, and the distinction between archive and backup — and the regulatory expectations under 21 CFR Part 11 and EU GMP Annex 11.

blocks.zh: Appendix O6 — Operational Change and Configuration Management 運營變更與組態管理
blocks.en: Appendix O6 — Operational Change and Configuration Management

blocks.zh: 中文解說：運營變更管理的核心思維
blocks.en: Commentary: Core Thinking on Operational Change Management

blocks.zh: 專案變更 vs. 運營變更：同一天的分水嶺
blocks.en: Project Change vs. Operational Change: A Watershed on the Same Day

blocks.zh: 這是很多藥廠IT與驗證部門容易混淆的地方。GAMP 5明確要求：系統交付（handover）給生產使用的那一刻，變更管控就必須從「專案變更管理」切換到「運營變更管理」。
blocks.en: This is where pharma IT and validation departments often get confused. GAMP 5 is explicit: the moment a system is handed over (handover) for production use, change control must switch from "project change management" to "operational change management".

blocks.zh: 本質上是同一個邏輯——評估影響、授權、執行、驗證——但責任歸屬、文件格式、核准層級都不同了。
blocks.en: The underlying logic is the same (assess impact, authorize, implement, verify), but responsibilities, documentation formats and approval levels are all different.

blocks.zh: 實務建議：驗證報告或系統移交文件應明確記載這個切換時間點（go-live date），並附上第一個運營變更SOP的版本號碼。
blocks.en: Practical advice: the validation report or system handover document should clearly record the date of this switch (the go-live date) and cite the version number of the first operational change SOP.

blocks.zh: 類比：建築工地 vs. 已開幕的飯店
blocks.en: Analogy: A Construction Site vs. a Hotel That Has Opened

blocks.zh: 專案階段就像建築工地，工程師隨時可以更改設計圖，不需要通知住客。但飯店開幕後（go-live），同樣是換一扇門，就必須通知營運部門、評估對住客的影響、製作施工記錄——這就是運營變更管理的精神。
blocks.en: The project phase is like a construction site: engineers can change the drawings at any time without notifying guests. Once the hotel opens (go-live), even replacing a single door requires notifying operations, assessing the impact on guests and producing work records. That is the spirit of operational change management.

blocks.zh: 緊急變更（Emergency Change）：稽核常見問題
blocks.en: Emergency Change: A Common Audit Finding

blocks.zh: 緊急變更是最容易出現稽核缺失的地方。GAMP 5允許先執行、後補文件（retrospective documentation），但前提是：
blocks.en: Emergency changes are where audit deficiencies appear most often. GAMP 5 allows work to be done first and documented afterwards (retrospective documentation), provided that:

blocks.zh: SOP中有明確定義何謂「緊急」
blocks.en: The SOP clearly defines what counts as an "emergency"

blocks.zh: 補文件必須在規定時間內完成（通常24–72小時）
blocks.en: The retrospective documentation is completed within a defined time (typically 24-72 hours)

blocks.zh: 事後仍要進行完整的影響評估
blocks.en: A full impact assessment is still performed afterwards

blocks.zh: 稽查員常問：「您的緊急變更SOP規定幾小時內要完成追溯文件？實際執行記錄符合嗎？」——如果回答不出來，等同宣告這個流程形同虛設。
blocks.en: Inspectors often ask: "Within how many hours does your emergency change SOP require retrospective documentation to be completed? Do your actual records comply?" If you cannot answer, you have effectively declared the process to be a dead letter.

blocks.zh: 臨時變更（Temporary Change）：最容易被遺忘的炸彈
blocks.en: Temporary Change: The Most Easily Forgotten Time Bomb

blocks.zh: 臨時性變更因為「只是暫時」而容易疏於管控。GAMP 5特別強調兩個要求：
blocks.en: Because they are "only temporary", temporary changes tend to escape control. GAMP 5 stresses two requirements:

blocks.zh: 必須有到期回滾機制——誰負責確認臨時變更已在計畫時間內還原？
blocks.en: There must be an expiry and rollback mechanism — who is responsible for confirming that the temporary change was reverted within the planned time?

blocks.zh: 不能無限期延期——若需要永久保留，必須走正式變更流程重新評估
blocks.en: It cannot be extended indefinitely — if it needs to be kept permanently, it must be re-assessed through the formal change process

blocks.zh: CDMO實務中，臨時的workaround最終變成永久配置的情況相當普遍，這是數據完整性風險的溫床。
blocks.en: In CDMO practice, it is quite common for a temporary workaround to end up as a permanent configuration, which is a breeding ground for data integrity risk.

blocks.zh: 組態基線（Configuration Baseline）：驗證狀態的錨點
blocks.en: Configuration Baseline: The Anchor of the Validated State

blocks.zh: Configuration baseline就是系統在某個時間點的「快照」——所有元件的版本號、設定值、介面定義——這是判斷系統是否仍處於驗證狀態的參照依據。
blocks.en: A configuration baseline is a "snapshot" of the system at a point in time (version numbers of all components, setting values and interface definitions). It is the reference for judging whether the system is still in a validated state.

blocks.zh: 每一次變更後，configuration baseline必須更新。如果實際系統狀態與記錄中的baseline不符，等同系統脫離驗證狀態，這是嚴重的GxP問題。
blocks.en: The configuration baseline must be updated after every change. If the actual system state does not match the recorded baseline, the system has effectively left the validated state, which is a serious GxP problem.

blocks.zh: SaaS供應商自動升版：被動的驗證挑戰
blocks.en: SaaS Vendor Automatic Upgrades: A Passive Validation Challenge

blocks.zh: 許多企業使用雲端SaaS（如SAP、Veeva Vault），供應商會定期自動推送新版本，企業無法阻止。GAMP 5要求企業必須主動評估每次版本更新對業務流程的影響——即使你沒有選擇更新的權利，你仍然有評估和記錄的責任。
blocks.en: Many companies use cloud SaaS (such as SAP or Veeva Vault), where the vendor pushes new versions on a regular basis and the company cannot stop them. GAMP 5 requires the company to proactively assess the impact of each release on its business processes. Even if you have no right to choose whether to update, you still have the responsibility to assess and document.

blocks.zh: 變更類型速查表
blocks.en: Change Type Quick Reference

blocks.zh: Appendix O7 — RetiredRETIRED Appendix O7 — 已廢止
blocks.en: Appendix O7 — Retired

blocks.zh: 中文說明
blocks.en: Commentary

blocks.zh: O7 已退役
blocks.en: O7 Retired

blocks.zh: GAMP 5第二版將原本獨立的「修復管理」附錄整合進O6（運營變更管理）。修復活動現在被歸類為標準變更或系統管理任務，不再需要獨立的附錄。這是GAMP 5第二版整合簡化的其中一個例子。
blocks.en: In the second edition, GAMP 5 folded the formerly separate "repair management" appendix into O6 (operational change management). Repair activities are now classified as standard changes or system administration tasks and no longer need a separate appendix. This is one example of the consolidation and simplification in the second edition.

blocks.zh: Appendix O8 — Periodic Review 定期審查
blocks.en: Appendix O8 — Periodic Review

blocks.zh: 中文解說：定期審查——最常被忽視的GxP活動
blocks.en: Commentary: Periodic Review, the Most Neglected GxP Activity

blocks.zh: 定期審查：CDMO最容易失分的地方
blocks.en: Periodic Review: Where CDMOs Most Often Lose Points

blocks.zh: 在實際稽查中，定期審查往往是最常被發現「有SOP但沒有執行」或「做了但沒有品質的記錄」的活動。常見問題：
blocks.en: In actual inspections, periodic review is often the activity most frequently found to be "covered by an SOP but not performed" or "performed but with no quality records". Common problems:

blocks.zh: 沒有基於風險的審查頻率（就是固定每年一次，沒有分析為何是一年）
blocks.en: No risk-based review frequency (simply once a year, with no analysis of why one year)

blocks.zh: 審查報告只是勾選清單，沒有趨勢分析
blocks.en: The review report is just a tick-box checklist with no trend analysis

blocks.zh: 缺失項目沒有可追蹤的CAPA
blocks.en: Deficiencies have no traceable CAPA

blocks.zh: 找不到「繼續使用聲明」（statement of acceptability）
blocks.en: The statement of acceptability cannot be found

blocks.zh: 風險基礎的頻率決策
blocks.en: Risk-Based Frequency Decisions

blocks.zh: GAMP 5第二版不再規定固定的審查週期，而是要求以風險評估決定頻率。實務上的決策邏輯：
blocks.en: The second edition of GAMP 5 no longer prescribes a fixed review interval; it requires the frequency to be determined by risk assessment. The practical decision logic is:

blocks.zh: 高風險系統（直接GxP影響）：每年一次，若發生重大事件則提前
blocks.en: High-risk systems (direct GxP impact): once a year, or earlier if a major event occurs

blocks.zh: 中風險系統（間接GxP影響）：每2–3年一次，成熟穩定系統可延長
blocks.en: Medium-risk systems (indirect GxP impact): every 2-3 years, which may be extended for mature, stable systems

blocks.zh: 低風險系統：每3–5年一次，或根據系統變更觸發
blocks.en: Low-risk systems: every 3-5 years, or triggered by system changes

blocks.zh: 關鍵：頻率決策必須有書面風險評估支持，不能是主觀決定。
blocks.en: Key point: the frequency decision must be supported by a documented risk assessment and cannot be a subjective choice.

blocks.zh: 類比：汽車定期保養 vs. 定期審查
blocks.en: Analogy: Regular Car Servicing vs. Periodic Review

blocks.zh: 定期審查就像汽車年度安全檢驗（車檢）。你不是在測試車子能不能開（那是驗證），你是在確認這輛車在過去一年的使用中沒有出現任何安全隱患——煞車有沒有磨損趨勢？輪胎氣壓記錄是否正常？有沒有未解決的警示燈？
blocks.en: Periodic review is like the annual vehicle safety inspection. You are not testing whether the car can run (that is validation); you are confirming that no safety hazards have emerged during the past year of use. Is there a wear trend in the brakes? Are the tyre pressure records normal? Are there any unresolved warning lights?

blocks.zh: 1年 vs. 3年審查：應涵蓋的重點不同
blocks.en: 1-Year vs. 3-Year Reviews: Different Focus Areas

blocks.zh: 年度審查重點：事件趨勢、變更記錄、存取權限審查、備份測試記錄、待結案行動項目
blocks.en: Annual review focus: incident trends, change records, access rights review, backup test records, open action items

blocks.zh: 3年深度審查重點：重新評估整體驗證狀態、技術過時風險（software end-of-life）、法規要求變化、供應商評估更新、業務流程重大變化
blocks.en: 3-year in-depth review focus: reassessment of the overall validation status, technology obsolescence risk (software end-of-life), changes in regulatory requirements, updated supplier assessment, major changes in business processes

blocks.zh: 「繼續使用聲明」的重要性
blocks.en: The Importance of the Statement of Acceptability

blocks.zh: 很多審查報告漏掉這一項——每次審查最終必須有一個明確的聲明：「本系統繼續符合預期用途，可在下次定期審查前持續使用。」這個聲明是系統維持驗證狀態的法規依據之一。
blocks.en: Many review reports omit this: every review must end with a clear statement such as "The system continues to meet its intended use and may continue to be used until the next periodic review." This statement is one of the regulatory bases for the system maintaining its validated state.

blocks.zh: 如果審查發現缺失，也要說明：「在以下CAPA完成後，本系統仍可繼續使用，理由如下...」
blocks.en: If the review finds deficiencies, it must also state: "The system may continue to be used once the following CAPAs are completed, for the following reasons..."

blocks.zh: CDMO實務：定期審查排程管理
blocks.en: CDMO Practice: Managing the Periodic Review Schedule

blocks.zh: 建議在系統清單（system inventory / CMDB）中記錄每個系統的：
blocks.en: It is recommended to record the following for each system in the system inventory / CMDB:

blocks.zh: 最後一次定期審查日期
blocks.en: Date of the last periodic review

blocks.zh: 下次審查到期日期
blocks.en: Due date of the next review

blocks.zh: 審查負責人（process owner）
blocks.en: Reviewer in charge (process owner)

blocks.zh: 風險等級（決定頻率）
blocks.en: Risk level (which determines the frequency)

blocks.zh: 品保部門可用這份清單作為監控工具，提前60天發出提醒，確保審查不會逾期。
blocks.en: QA can use this list as a monitoring tool and issue reminders 60 days ahead to make sure reviews are not overdue.

blocks.zh: Appendix O9 — Backup and Restore 備份與還原
blocks.en: Appendix O9 — Backup and Restore

blocks.zh: 中文解說：備份 vs. 還原——稽查的真正關注點
blocks.en: Commentary: Backup vs. Restore, the Real Focus of Inspections

blocks.zh: 最常見的稽查發現：有備份，沒有測試還原
blocks.en: The Most Common Inspection Finding: Backups Exist, but Restores Are Not Tested

blocks.zh: 這是許多CDMO企業的共同問題。IT團隊每天都在備份，備份日誌也顯示成功——但從來沒有實際執行過還原測試（restore test）。
blocks.en: This is a shared problem in many CDMOs. The IT team backs up every day and the backup logs show success, but a restore test has never actually been performed.

blocks.zh: 稽查員的問題：「請給我看最近一次備份還原測試的記錄，以及還原後的資料完整性驗證記錄。」如果你拿不出來，這就是一個觀察缺失（observation）甚至重大缺失（major finding）。
blocks.en: The inspector's question: "Please show me the record of the most recent backup restore test and the data integrity verification record after the restore." If you cannot produce them, this is an observation or even a major finding.

blocks.zh: RPO vs. RTO：兩個不同的問題
blocks.en: RPO vs. RTO: Two Different Questions

blocks.zh: RPO（Recovery Point Objective）恢復點目標：「我可以接受損失多少時間的資料？」例如RPO=4小時，意味著最壞情況下損失4小時的資料是可接受的。這決定了備份頻率。
blocks.en: RPO (Recovery Point Objective): "How much data, measured in time, can I afford to lose?" For example, RPO = 4 hours means that in the worst case, losing 4 hours of data is acceptable. This determines the backup frequency.

blocks.zh: RTO（Recovery Time Objective）恢復時間目標：「我可以接受系統停機多久？」例如RTO=8小時，意味著系統必須在8小時內恢復運作。這決定了還原方案的技術要求。
blocks.en: RTO (Recovery Time Objective): "How long can I accept the system being down?" For example, RTO = 8 hours means the system must be back in operation within 8 hours. This determines the technical requirements of the restore solution.

blocks.zh: RPO和RTO必須由業務負責人（process owner）定義，而不是IT部門自行決定——因為這是業務風險決策，不是技術決策。
blocks.en: RPO and RTO must be defined by the business owner (process owner), not decided by the IT department alone, because this is a business risk decision, not a technical decision.

blocks.zh: 類比：消防演練 vs. 備份測試
blocks.en: Analogy: Fire Drill vs. Backup Testing

blocks.zh: 備份就像消防設備（滅火器、噴水系統）。定期測試備份/還原就像消防演練。你有消防設備，但從來沒有演練過——萬一真的失火，你無法保證設備會正常運作，也不知道員工應該怎麼疏散。
blocks.en: Backups are like fire-fighting equipment (extinguishers, sprinkler systems). Regular backup/restore testing is like a fire drill. If you have the equipment but have never run a drill, then in a real fire you cannot guarantee the equipment will work, and you do not know how staff should evacuate.

blocks.zh: 同理，備份日誌「成功」只代表備份動作完成，不代表還原一定能成功——只有實際執行還原測試才能驗證這一點。
blocks.en: In the same way, a "successful" backup log only shows that the backup action completed; it does not mean a restore will succeed. Only an actual restore test can verify that.

blocks.zh: 備份 vs. 歸檔：根本不同的目的
blocks.en: Backup vs. Archive: Fundamentally Different Purposes

blocks.zh: GAMP 5明確指出：備份不能替代歸檔。備份可能只保留30天的資料，但法規要求的記錄保留期可能是30年。
blocks.en: GAMP 5 states explicitly: backup cannot replace archiving. A backup may retain only 30 days of data, while the regulatory record retention period may be 30 years.

blocks.zh: CDMO建議做法：備份還原測試程序
blocks.en: Recommended CDMO Practice: Backup Restore Test Procedure

blocks.zh: 測試頻率：每季至少一次（高風險系統），每半年一次（中低風險系統）
blocks.en: Test frequency: at least quarterly for high-risk systems, and every six months for medium- and low-risk systems

blocks.zh: 測試範圍：選擇包含GxP資料的備份組，在非生產環境中執行還原
blocks.en: Test scope: select a backup set containing GxP data and perform the restore in a non-production environment

blocks.zh: 驗證項目：資料完整性、audit trail完整性、metadata保留、還原所需時間（對照RTO）
blocks.en: Items to verify: data integrity, audit trail integrity, metadata retention, and time required for the restore (against the RTO)

blocks.zh: 文件要求：還原測試記錄、比對結果、責任人簽名、偏差記錄（若有）
blocks.en: Documentation requirements: restore test record, comparison results, signature of the responsible person, and deviation record (if any)

blocks.zh: GxP稽核軌跡的備份：容易遺漏的細節
blocks.en: Backing Up the GxP Audit Trail: An Easily Missed Detail

blocks.zh: 許多備份策略只涵蓋業務資料，但GAMP 5明確要求：GxP audit trail也必須被備份，而且備份的audit trail資料必須包含metadata（使其有意義）。
blocks.en: Many backup strategies cover only business data, but GAMP 5 is explicit: the GxP audit trail must also be backed up, and the backed-up audit trail data must include metadata (so that it remains meaningful).

blocks.zh: 更細膩的要求：備份軟體本身的metadata（記錄每次備份的時間點、內容的索引）也必須備份——否則備份軟體故障時，你可能無法利用備份資料來還原。
blocks.en: A finer requirement: the metadata of the backup software itself (the index recording the time point and content of each backup) must also be backed up. Otherwise, if the backup software fails, you may not be able to use the backup data to restore.

blocks.zh: Appendix O10 — Business Continuity Management 業務持續管理
blocks.en: Appendix O10 — Business Continuity Management

blocks.zh: 中文解說：業務持續管理與災難恢復
blocks.en: Commentary: Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery

blocks.zh: BC vs. DR：層次不同，目的不同
blocks.en: BC vs. DR: Different Levels, Different Purposes

blocks.zh: 災難恢復（DR）是IT層面的問題：如何在規定時間（RTO）內將系統和資料恢復到可接受的狀態（RPO）。
blocks.en: Disaster recovery (DR) is an IT-level matter: how to restore systems and data to an acceptable state (RPO) within a defined time (RTO).

blocks.zh: 業務持續（BC）是業務層面的問題：在IT系統無法立即恢復期間，業務如何用替代方式繼續運作？
blocks.en: Business continuity (BC) is a business-level matter: while IT systems cannot be restored immediately, how does the business keep operating by alternative means?

blocks.zh: 類比：DR是叫救護車（快速恢復），BC是有急救箱和受過急救訓練的員工（在救護車到來前維持生命體徵）。
blocks.en: Analogy: DR is calling an ambulance (fast recovery); BC is having a first-aid kit and staff trained in first aid (maintaining vital signs until the ambulance arrives).

blocks.zh: CDMO最容易忽略的BCP要素
blocks.en: BCP Elements CDMOs Most Often Overlook

blocks.zh: 手動備援程序：如果MES/LIMS停機，批次記錄怎麼辦？紙本表單在哪裡？誰有授權使用？
blocks.en: Manual fallback procedures: if MES/LIMS goes down, what happens to the batch record? Where are the paper forms? Who is authorized to use them?

blocks.zh: 恢復後的資料同步：手動記錄如何在系統恢復後重新輸入並維持稽核軌跡？
blocks.en: Data synchronization after recovery: how will manual records be re-entered after the system is restored, while maintaining the audit trail?

blocks.zh: 供應商依賴：如果唯一的冷鏈服務商無法運作，有替代方案嗎？
blocks.en: Supplier dependency: if the only cold chain provider cannot operate, is there an alternative?

blocks.zh: 溝通樹（communication tree）：緊急聯絡清單是否定期更新？
blocks.en: Communication tree: is the emergency contact list updated regularly?

blocks.zh: 類比：演練 vs. 實際演習
blocks.en: Analogy: Rehearsal vs. Real Exercise

blocks.zh: BCP演練（rehearsal）不是紙上談兵。GAMP 5提到BCP可以用多種方式演練：review、brainstorming、walkthrough，以及實際切換到備援系統（hot site testing）。
blocks.en: A BCP rehearsal is not paper talk. GAMP 5 mentions that a BCP can be exercised in several ways: review, brainstorming, walkthrough, and actually switching over to a backup system (hot site testing).

blocks.zh: 稽查員會問：「您最近一次BCP演練是什麼時候？演練了哪些場景？有沒有發現任何問題？問題是否已解決？」——每個問題都需要書面證據。
blocks.en: Inspectors will ask: "When was your most recent BCP rehearsal? Which scenarios were exercised? Were any problems found? Have they been resolved?" Every one of these needs documented evidence.

blocks.zh: 系統恢復優先順序：必須事先定義
blocks.en: System Recovery Priority: Must Be Defined in Advance

blocks.zh: 當多個系統同時故障時（大規模災難情境），你必須事先定義恢復順序。一般邏輯：
blocks.en: When several systems fail at the same time (a large-scale disaster scenario), the restore order must be defined in advance. The general logic is:

blocks.zh: 基礎設施（網路、伺服器、資料庫）
blocks.en: Infrastructure (network, servers, databases)

blocks.zh: 直接影響病患安全的系統（製造執行、批次記錄）
blocks.en: Systems with direct impact on patient safety (manufacturing execution, batch records)

blocks.zh: 品管系統（LIMS、品質文件）
blocks.en: Quality control systems (LIMS, quality documentation)

blocks.zh: 企業資源規劃（ERP）
blocks.en: Enterprise resource planning (ERP)

blocks.zh: 間接支援系統
blocks.en: Indirect support systems

blocks.zh: 這個優先順序應在DR計畫中明文規定，並由業務負責人確認。
blocks.en: This priority order should be stated explicitly in the DR plan and confirmed by the business owner.

blocks.zh: DR測試的實務建議
blocks.en: Practical Advice on DR Testing

blocks.zh: DR測試不需要每次都是全規模演練（full failover test），可以分層次：
blocks.en: DR testing does not always have to be a full failover test; it can be tiered:

blocks.zh: 文件審查（Document Review）：確認DR計畫是最新版本、聯絡清單正確
blocks.en: Document review: confirm that the DR plan is the current version and the contact list is correct

blocks.zh: 桌面推演（Tabletop Exercise）：模擬場景討論，識別計畫缺口
blocks.en: Tabletop exercise: discuss a simulated scenario to identify gaps in the plan

blocks.zh: 部分切換測試：測試特定系統的failover，不影響生產環境
blocks.en: Partial switchover test: test the failover of specific systems without affecting the production environment

blocks.zh: 全規模演練：每1–3年一次，視風險等級決定
blocks.en: Full-scale exercise: every 1-3 years, depending on risk level

blocks.zh: Appendix O11 — Security Management 資訊安全管理
blocks.en: Appendix O11 — Security Management

blocks.zh: 中文解說：製藥IT的資訊安全——GxP視角
blocks.en: Commentary: Information Security in Pharma IT from a GxP Perspective

blocks.zh: 共用帳號（Shared Accounts）：最嚴重的稽查缺失之一
blocks.en: Shared Accounts: One of the Most Serious Inspection Findings

blocks.zh: 稽查員最不喜歡看到的情況：多人共用一個系統帳號（例如「admin」或「lab1」）。原因：
blocks.en: The situation inspectors like least is several people sharing one system account (for example "admin" or "lab1"). The reasons:

blocks.zh: 無法確定是誰執行了特定操作（稽核軌跡失去歸屬性）
blocks.en: It is impossible to determine who performed a given action (the audit trail loses attributability)

blocks.zh: 21 CFR Part 11要求電子簽名必須能唯一識別個人
blocks.en: 21 CFR Part 11 requires that an electronic signature be unique to one individual

blocks.zh: EU GMP Annex 11 §12要求每位使用者必須有獨立登入帳號
blocks.en: EU GMP Annex 11 §12 requires each user to have an individual login account

blocks.zh: 即使是「只讀」的查詢帳號，如果多人共用，也構成潛在缺失——因為你無法重建誰在何時查看了什麼記錄。
blocks.en: Even a "read-only" query account is a potential deficiency if shared by several people, because you cannot reconstruct who viewed which records and when.

blocks.zh: 存取權限審查（Access Review）：被動到主動
blocks.en: Access Review: From Reactive to Proactive

blocks.zh: ISMS要求定期審查存取權限（Identity and Access Management），包括「starters, movers, and leavers」：
blocks.en: An ISMS requires periodic review of access rights (Identity and Access Management), including "starters, movers, and leavers":

blocks.zh: Starters（新進人員）：入職時根據職責給予最小必要權限
blocks.en: Starters (new joiners): grant the minimum necessary rights for their duties on joining

blocks.zh: Movers（職務異動）：轉調後舊職務的權限是否撤銷？
blocks.en: Movers (role changes): are the rights of the old role revoked after the transfer?

blocks.zh: Leavers（離職人員）：離職後帳號是否立即停用？
blocks.en: Leavers (departures): is the account disabled immediately after the person leaves?

blocks.zh: 稽查常見問題：離職員工的帳號在離職後數週甚至數月仍然有效。這是21 CFR Part 11的重大違規。
blocks.en: A common inspection finding: the accounts of departed employees are still active weeks or even months after departure. This is a major 21 CFR Part 11 violation.

blocks.zh: 類比：公寓門禁 vs. 系統存取
blocks.en: Analogy: Apartment Building Access Control vs. System Access

blocks.zh: 想像一個公寓大樓的門禁管理：每位住戶有自己的門卡，保全可以查詢誰在什麼時候進出了哪扇門。住戶搬出後，門卡立即停用。
blocks.en: Imagine access control in an apartment building: each resident has their own key card, and security can look up who went through which door and when. When a resident moves out, the card is deactivated immediately.

blocks.zh: 這就是GxP系統存取管理應該達到的水準。如果有人的門卡是別人借來的（共用帳號），或者已經搬出的住戶門卡還能使用（離職帳號未停用），這個大樓的安全管理就是不合格的。
blocks.en: This is the standard GxP system access management should reach. If someone's card is borrowed from another person (a shared account), or a resident who has moved out can still use their card (an account not disabled after departure), the building's security management is unacceptable.

blocks.zh: 21 CFR Part 11 的安全管理含義
blocks.en: Security Management Implications of 21 CFR Part 11

blocks.zh: 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10 對電腦化系統的安全控制要求包括：
blocks.en: The security control requirements of 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10 for computerized systems include:

blocks.zh: §11.10(d)：限制系統存取給授權人員（即基於角色的存取控制）
blocks.en: §11.10(d): limiting system access to authorized individuals (that is, role-based access control)

blocks.zh: §11.10(g)：使用授權/密碼檢查確保存取的唯一性
blocks.en: §11.10(g): use of authority checks / password checks to ensure that access is unique to the individual

blocks.zh: §11.10(j)：教育、訓練、培訓記錄的維護
blocks.en: §11.10(j): maintenance of education, training and experience records

blocks.zh: §11.300：電子簽名的控制——唯一性、密碼定期更換
blocks.en: §11.300: controls for electronic signatures: uniqueness and periodic password changes

blocks.zh: GAMP 5的安全管理要求與21 CFR Part 11直接對應。任何GxP系統的安全評估都應包含Part 11合規性確認。
blocks.en: The security management requirements of GAMP 5 map directly to 21 CFR Part 11. Any security assessment of a GxP system should include confirmation of Part 11 compliance.

blocks.zh: 安全補丁管理：GxP環境的特殊考量
blocks.en: Security Patch Management: Special Considerations for GxP Environments

blocks.zh: 許多企業IT部門因為擔心「補丁破壞驗證狀態」而拖延安全補丁的部署。GAMP 5明確回應這個問題：安全補丁對業務功能的影響風險很低，不應以此為由拖延部署。
blocks.en: Many corporate IT departments delay deploying security patches because they fear that "patches will break the validated state". GAMP 5 addresses this concern directly: the risk of a security patch affecting business functionality is low and should not be used as a reason to delay deployment.

blocks.zh: 建議的部署流程：Dev環境→Test/Validation環境→非GxP生產環境→GxP生產環境，每步驟之間確認沒有功能影響。
blocks.en: Recommended deployment flow: Dev environment → Test/Validation environment → non-GxP production environment → GxP production environment, confirming at each step that there is no functional impact.

blocks.zh: 未打補丁的系統反而是更大的GxP風險——數據完整性因安全漏洞被利用而受損，是比補丁管理更嚴重的問題。
blocks.en: An unpatched system is actually the greater GxP risk: data integrity compromised through exploited security vulnerabilities is a more serious problem than patch management.

blocks.zh: CDMO資安實踐清單
blocks.en: CDMO Information Security Practice Checklist

blocks.zh: 每位使用者有唯一帳號（禁止共用帳號）
blocks.en: Each user has a unique account (shared accounts prohibited)

blocks.zh: 系統管理員帳號與一般帳號分開（特權存取管理）
blocks.en: System administrator accounts are separate from ordinary accounts (privileged access management)

blocks.zh: MFA已為高風險系統（尤其是遠端存取）啟用
blocks.en: MFA is enabled for high-risk systems (especially for remote access)

blocks.zh: 離職/調職流程包含即時帳號停用/調整步驟
blocks.en: The leaver/transfer process includes immediate account deactivation/adjustment steps

blocks.zh: 每年至少一次存取權限全面審查（包括服務帳號）
blocks.en: A full access rights review (including service accounts) at least once a year

blocks.zh: 安全補丁部署有書面流程，不超過供應商建議的時間窗口
blocks.en: Security patch deployment follows a documented process and stays within the time window recommended by the vendor

blocks.zh: 系統時鐘同步（NTP）——與稽核軌跡完整性直接相關
blocks.en: System clock synchronization (NTP), which is directly related to audit trail integrity

blocks.zh: Appendix O12 — System Administration 系統管理
blocks.en: Appendix O12 — System Administration

blocks.zh: 中文解說：系統管理——特權存取的管控
blocks.en: Commentary: System Administration and Control of Privileged Access

blocks.zh: 特權存取管理（Privileged Access Management, PAM）
blocks.en: Privileged Access Management (PAM)

blocks.zh: 系統管理員帳號（admin accounts）的特殊之處在於它們可以：繞過應用程式層的存取控制、直接修改資料庫、停用稽核軌跡、刪除記錄。
blocks.en: What makes system administrator accounts (admin accounts) special is that they can bypass application-layer access controls, modify the database directly, disable the audit trail and delete records.

blocks.zh: GAMP 5要求「最小權限原則」（principle of least privilege）：管理員只應擁有執行其職責所需的最低限度的權限，且應分配給盡可能少的人員。
blocks.en: GAMP 5 requires the "principle of least privilege": administrators should have only the minimum privileges needed to perform their duties, and these should be assigned to as few people as possible.

blocks.zh: 稽核軌跡完整性與系統時鐘同步
blocks.en: Audit Trail Integrity and System Clock Synchronization

blocks.zh: O12（系統管理）與O11（安全管理）都提到系統時鐘同步控制。這不只是IT管理的問題，而是數據完整性的核心議題：
blocks.en: Both O12 (system administration) and O11 (security management) mention system clock synchronization controls. This is not just an IT management issue but a core data integrity issue:

blocks.zh: 如果系統時鐘不同步，不同系統的稽核軌跡時間戳記就無法對應
blocks.en: If system clocks are not synchronized, audit trail timestamps in different systems cannot be correlated

blocks.zh: 事件序列（event sequence）重建將出現矛盾
blocks.en: Reconstruction of the event sequence will produce contradictions

blocks.zh: FDA 21 CFR Part 11和EU GMP Annex 11都強調電子記錄的時間戳記準確性
blocks.en: FDA 21 CFR Part 11 and EU GMP Annex 11 both stress the accuracy of electronic record timestamps

blocks.zh: 實務建議：所有GxP系統應強制使用NTP（Network Time Protocol）同步到可追溯的時間源，並定期驗證時鐘精確度（通常允許±1分鐘）。
blocks.en: Practical advice: all GxP systems should be forced to synchronize via NTP (Network Time Protocol) to a traceable time source, with clock accuracy verified periodically (typically ±1 minute is allowed).

blocks.zh: 類比：系統管理員帳號是「萬能鑰匙」
blocks.en: Analogy: The Administrator Account Is a "Master Key"

blocks.zh: 管理員帳號就像大樓的萬能鑰匙——可以進入所有房間。正因為如此，持有萬能鑰匙的人必須：身份可追溯、使用有記錄、數量最小化、非工作時間不得使用。
blocks.en: An administrator account is like the master key of a building, which opens every room. For that reason, whoever holds a master key must have a traceable identity, have their use recorded, be kept to a minimum number of people, and not use it outside working hours.

blocks.zh: 許多稽查發現：管理員帳號密碼是口頭告知、沒有個人化、長期不更換。這使稽核軌跡完全失效——「admin登入修改了批次記錄」，但不知道是誰。
blocks.en: Many inspection findings: the administrator password is passed on verbally, is not personalized and is not changed for a long time. This makes the audit trail completely ineffective: "admin logged in and modified the batch record", but nobody knows who.

blocks.zh: 職責分離（Segregation of Duties）的實踐
blocks.en: Putting Segregation of Duties into Practice

blocks.zh: GAMP 5要求系統管理職責與業務操作職責分離。實務含義：
blocks.en: GAMP 5 requires system administration duties to be segregated from business operation duties. In practice this means:

blocks.zh: 可以執行批次記錄的操作員，不應有管理員權限
blocks.en: An operator who can execute batch record operations should not have administrator privileges

blocks.zh: 可以修改系統設定的管理員，不應有授權批次放行的權限
blocks.en: An administrator who can modify system settings should not have the authority to release batches

blocks.zh: 可以創建用戶帳號的IT人員，不應有業務審批權
blocks.en: IT staff who can create user accounts should not have business approval authority

blocks.zh: 這一原則直接影響21 CFR Part 11的合規性——電子簽名的有效性建立在「只有授權人員才能執行特定操作」的前提上。
blocks.en: This principle directly affects 21 CFR Part 11 compliance: the validity of an electronic signature rests on the premise that only authorized personnel can perform specific operations.

blocks.zh: 系統管理計畫（System Administration Plan）的內容
blocks.en: Contents of the System Administration Plan

blocks.zh: 每個GxP系統應有一份系統管理計畫，記錄：
blocks.en: Each GxP system should have a system administration plan that records:

blocks.zh: 定期執行的管理任務清單（含頻率）
blocks.en: A list of the administration tasks performed regularly (with frequency)

blocks.zh: 每項任務的SOP/WI編號
blocks.en: The SOP/WI number for each task

blocks.zh: 執行人員的資格要求
blocks.en: Qualification requirements for the persons performing them

blocks.zh: 記錄保存要求
blocks.en: Record retention requirements

blocks.zh: 例外情況的升報機制
blocks.en: Escalation mechanism for exceptions

blocks.zh: Appendix O13 — Archiving and Retrieval 歸檔與檢索
blocks.en: Appendix O13 — Archiving and Retrieval

blocks.zh: 中文解說：電子記錄歸檔——30年後仍能讀取
blocks.en: Commentary: Archiving Electronic Records, Still Readable After 30 Years

blocks.zh: 法規對記錄保留期的要求
blocks.en: Regulatory Requirements for Record Retention Periods

blocks.zh: 不同法規對製藥記錄保留期有不同要求：
blocks.en: Different regulations set different retention periods for pharmaceutical records:

blocks.zh: 21 CFR Part 211（cGMP）：批次記錄保留至產品效期後1年，但不少於3年
blocks.en: 21 CFR Part 211 (cGMP): batch records are retained for 1 year after the expiration date of the product, but for not less than 3 years

blocks.zh: FDA ICH E6（臨床試驗）：通常15年以上
blocks.en: FDA ICH E6 (clinical trials): usually 15 years or more

blocks.zh: EU GMP Annex 11 §17：要求電子記錄在保留期間內「可讀且可取得」
blocks.en: EU GMP Annex 11 §17: requires electronic records to be "readable and accessible" throughout the retention period

blocks.zh: 生物製品（BLA產品）：效期後通常需保留更長（部分要求30年以上）
blocks.en: Biological products (BLA products): typically a longer retention after expiry (some requirements are 30 years or more)

blocks.zh: CDMO的挑戰：你今天用的軟體，30年後還會被支援嗎？廠商還存在嗎？這不是誇張——這是真實的合規風險。
blocks.en: The CDMO challenge: will the software you use today still be supported in 30 years? Will the vendor still exist? This is not an exaggeration; it is a real compliance risk.

blocks.zh: 格式過時的風險：「讀不出來」就是不合規
blocks.en: Format Obsolescence Risk: "Unreadable" Means Non-Compliant

blocks.zh: FDA最關心的問題之一：電子記錄必須在整個保留期間內保持「可讀且有意義」（accessible, readable, and meaningful）。這意味著：
blocks.en: One of the FDA's biggest concerns: electronic records must remain "accessible, readable, and meaningful" throughout the retention period. This means:

blocks.zh: 用專有格式存儲的記錄，如果軟體停止支援，等同記錄丟失
blocks.en: Records stored in a proprietary format are effectively lost if the software stops being supported

blocks.zh: 電子簽名的metadata（簽名者、時間、簽名含義）必須與記錄一起保存
blocks.en: The metadata of electronic signatures (signer, time, meaning of the signature) must be retained together with the record

blocks.zh: 定期「格式重整」（format migration）可能是必要的——需有書面流程
blocks.en: Periodic format migration may be necessary, and a documented procedure is needed

blocks.zh: 建議：優先使用開放格式（PDF/A、XML）或確保有長期的格式轉換策略。
blocks.en: Recommendation: prefer open formats (PDF/A, XML) or make sure there is a long-term format conversion strategy.

blocks.zh: 類比：老舊VHS錄影帶
blocks.en: Analogy: Old VHS Tapes

blocks.zh: 想像你把1990年代的重要影片錄在VHS錄影帶上。現在（30年後）你還能看嗎？大部分人家裡已經沒有VHS播放機了，更不用說30年後。
blocks.en: Imagine you recorded important video from the 1990s on VHS tapes. Can you still watch it now (30 years later)? Most households no longer have a VHS player, let alone 30 years from now.

blocks.zh: 電子記錄的歸檔問題類似：格式再好，如果讀取工具不在了，記錄等於不存在。這就是為什麼GAMP 5要求「週期性可讀性測試」（periodic readability testing）和「系統升版時的同步更新」。
blocks.en: The archiving problem for electronic records is similar: however good the format, if the reading tools are gone, the records might as well not exist. This is why GAMP 5 requires "periodic readability testing" and "synchronized updates when the system is upgraded".

blocks.zh: 電子簽名的可歸因性（Attributability）：歸檔後仍要保留
blocks.en: Attributability of Electronic Signatures: Must Be Preserved After Archiving

blocks.zh: 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10(e) 要求電子記錄上的電子簽名必須是可驗證和可歸因的。歸檔後，這個要求不會消失。
blocks.en: 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10(e) requires that electronic signatures on electronic records be verifiable and attributable. This requirement does not disappear after archiving.

blocks.zh: 實務問題：如果你把記錄從原始系統匯出為PDF，電子簽名的metadata（簽名者的帳號、時間戳、簽名的「含義」如「reviewed」「approved」）是否被保留？
blocks.en: Practical question: if you export a record from the original system to PDF, are the electronic signature metadata (the signer's account, the timestamp, and the signature "meaning" such as "reviewed" or "approved") preserved?

blocks.zh: 僅匯出顯示為「Smith, J. - Approved - 2024-01-15」的文字是不夠的——必須能夠驗證這個簽名是真實的，而不是後來被手動輸入的。
blocks.en: It is not enough to export text that reads "Smith, J. - Approved - 2024-01-15"; it must be possible to verify that this signature is genuine and was not typed in manually afterwards.

blocks.zh: 舊系統保留 vs. 記錄遷移：兩難困境
blocks.en: Retaining the Legacy System vs. Migrating Records: A Dilemma

blocks.zh: 系統升版後，舊系統的記錄有兩個選擇：
blocks.en: After a system upgrade, there are two options for the records in the old system:

blocks.zh: 保留舊系統（Retain Legacy System）：維護成本高、技術風險高（硬體故障、軟體授權到期），但最能保持記錄原貌
blocks.en: Retain the legacy system: high maintenance cost and high technical risk (hardware failure, expiring software licences), but best preserves the original form of the records

blocks.zh: 遷移到新格式（Record Migration）：需要完整的驗證遷移過程，必須能證明遷移後的記錄與原始記錄完全一致
blocks.en: Migrate to a new format (record migration): requires a fully validated migration process, and it must be possible to prove that the migrated records are identical to the original records

blocks.zh: GAMP 5建議：考慮將舊系統虛擬化（virtualization）作為降低硬體風險的方法，但仍需考慮長期維護能力。
blocks.en: GAMP 5 suggests considering virtualization of the legacy system as a way to reduce hardware risk, while still considering long-term maintainability.

blocks.zh: Data Archiving Plan（DAP）：CDMO應包含的核心內容
blocks.en: Data Archiving Plan (DAP): Core Contents a CDMO Should Include

blocks.zh: 每個GxP系統的DAP應包含：
blocks.en: The DAP for each GxP system should include:

blocks.zh: 記錄類型清單與對應保留期（reference to regulatory basis）
blocks.en: A list of record types and corresponding retention periods (with reference to the regulatory basis)

blocks.zh: 觸發歸檔的條件（例如：批次關閉後X天、儲存空間達到Y%）
blocks.en: Conditions that trigger archiving (for example, X days after batch closure, or storage reaching Y%)

blocks.zh: 歸檔格式規格（包含為何選擇此格式的理由）
blocks.en: Archive format specification (including the rationale for choosing the format)

blocks.zh: 歸檔驗證計畫（初次 + 週期性）
blocks.en: Archive validation plan (initial and periodic)

blocks.zh: 可讀性測試週期和方法（如每3年一次格式可讀性驗證）
blocks.en: Readability test cycle and method (for example, format readability verification every 3 years)

blocks.zh: 記錄銷毀授權流程（保留期結束後的依規銷毀）
blocks.en: Authorization process for record destruction (destruction in accordance with requirements after the retention period ends)

blocks.zh: 系統升版時的DAP更新流程
blocks.en: Process for updating the DAP when the system is upgraded

blocks.zh: 備份 vs. 歸檔：完整對比
blocks.en: Backup vs. Archive: Full Comparison

blocks.zh: Section Summary — Appendices O6–O13 本節摘要
blocks.en: Section Summary — Appendices O6–O13

blocks.zh: O6 Operational Change Management: Change control governance transfers from project mode to operational mode at system handover. Six change types require different control pathways; emergency changes allow retrospective documentation but require predefined criteria and time limits. Configuration baselines must be maintained and updated with every change. 運營變更管理從系統移交即生效；六種變更類型各有管控路徑；配置基線是驗證狀態的錨點。
blocks.en: O6 Operational Change Management: Change control governance transfers from project mode to operational mode at system handover. Six change types require different control pathways; emergency changes allow retrospective documentation but require predefined criteria and time limits. Configuration baselines must be maintained and updated with every change.

blocks.zh: O7 Retired: Repair activities now managed under O6 change types. O7退役，修復活動納入O6管理。
blocks.en: O7 Retired: Repair activities now managed under O6 change types.

blocks.zh: O8 Periodic Review: Risk-based frequency determination; multi-disciplinary team; scope covers incidents, changes, access rights, backup testing, audit trails, and training. Every review must produce a statement of acceptability. 定期審查頻率由風險評估決定；必須涵蓋事件趨勢、變更記錄、存取審查等；每次審查必須出具繼續使用聲明。
blocks.en: O8 Periodic Review: Risk-based frequency determination; multi-disciplinary team; scope covers incidents, changes, access rights, backup testing, audit trails, and training. Every review must produce a statement of acceptability.

blocks.zh: O9 Backup and Restore: RPO/RTO defined by business owners, not IT. Backup strategy must be verified through restore testing — backup creation alone is insufficient. GxP audit trails and backup metadata must both be backed up. 備份策略的RPO/RTO由業務負責人定義；還原測試是稽查重點；稽核軌跡和備份metadata都必須納入備份範圍。
blocks.en: O9 Backup and Restore: RPO/RTO defined by business owners, not IT. Backup strategy must be verified through restore testing — backup creation alone is insufficient. GxP audit trails and backup metadata must both be backed up.

blocks.zh: O10 Business Continuity: BC keeps business running during disruption; DR restores systems. BCPs must be rehearsed and include post-recovery data reconciliation procedures. DR plans must define system restore priority order. BC維持業務運作，DR恢復系統；BCP必須定期演練；DR計畫需明定系統恢復優先順序。
blocks.en: O10 Business Continuity: BC keeps business running during disruption; DR restores systems. BCPs must be rehearsed and include post-recovery data reconciliation procedures. DR plans must define system restore priority order.

blocks.zh: O11 Security Management: Aligned with ISO 27001 and NIST. Key GxP concerns: unique user accounts (no sharing), access reviews for starters/movers/leavers, clock synchronization for audit trail integrity, and security patch deployment using risk-based approach. 與ISO 27001對齊；GxP核心議題包括唯一帳號、離職帳號管理、時鐘同步與安全補丁管理。
blocks.en: O11 Security Management: Aligned with ISO 27001 and NIST. Key GxP concerns: unique user accounts (no sharing), access reviews for starters/movers/leavers, clock synchronization for audit trail integrity, and security patch deployment using risk-based approach.

blocks.zh: O12 System Administration: Principle of least privilege for admin accounts; admin duties segregated from operational duties; all admin activities documented; system clocks synchronized via NTP. 管理員帳號採最小權限原則；管理職責與業務操作職責分離；系統時鐘同步是數據完整性要求。
blocks.en: O12 System Administration: Principle of least privilege for admin accounts; admin duties segregated from operational duties; all admin activities documented; system clocks synchronized via NTP.

blocks.zh: O13 Archiving and Retrieval: Distinct from backup — archives must remain readable and attributable for the full retention period (potentially 30+ years). Data Archiving Plans required; periodic readability testing; electronic signature metadata must survive the archiving process; format migration must be validated. 歸檔不同於備份；記錄必須在整個保留期（可達30年以上）保持可讀性與可歸因性；電子簽名metadata必須被保留；格式遷移需驗證。
blocks.en: O13 Archiving and Retrieval: Distinct from backup — archives must remain readable and attributable for the full retention period (potentially 30+ years). Data Archiving Plans required; periodic readability testing; electronic signature metadata must survive the archiving process; format migration must be validated.
